submission.justification: Selection-S1 (gradient-boosted classifier using all reconstructed variables, including jet substructure) gives the highest expected significance in the Monte Carlo study across the working points tested: 3.46 sigma at 20%, 4.10 at 30%, 4.27 at 40%, 4.03 at 50%, and 3.89 at 70% efficiency. The 40% working point is the scan maximum. S2 reached at most 3.55 sigma (at 50%) and S3 at most 2.67 sigma. These are statistical-only numbers, so the ranking is what matters, not the absolute values. The data/MC validation-region check is NOT verified: none of the project documents or tools report validation-region yield agreement for any strategy, and S1 relies on jet-substructure variables, which are a plausible source of mismodelling. The recommendation is therefore conditional. Before unblinding, the signal-free validation-region data/MC yield agreement must be confirmed to be within 10% for S1's variables at the 40% working point. If it is not, the fallback is S2, which uses kinematic variables only, and must be validated the same way. The sensitivity scan is also noisy, so the exact optimum could shift by a few percent.
